page.content:
Brutal house karate of Heihachi, Kazuya, and Jin.

How Mishima-style karate connects

  • Character: Heihachi Mishima — Heihachi fights in Mishima-style karate.
  • Character: Kazuya Mishima — Kazuya's Mishima-style karate mirrors his father's, with Devil layered on.
  • Character: Jin Kazama — Jin learned Mishima-style karate before mixing in Kazama and karate-do.

What is Mishima-style karate?

Mishima-style karate is the family's fighting art: forward dashes, electric winds, and the power game that makes the three Mishima men play like one bloodline.

Key threads lead to Heihachi Mishima, Kazuya Mishima and Jin Kazama.
